title: Sell Mineral Rights in Eden, WY
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Eden, WY | Sweetwater County
metaDescription: Eden, WY sits in an irrigated valley near Sweetwater County's Continental Divide gas trend and the Union Pacific checkerboard. Get an honest mineral read.
heroLead: Eden sits in an irrigated farming valley that got its name from the reclamation project that turned this stretch of high desert green, and it also sits close enough to the checkerboard and the Continental Divide gas trend that I check both before saying anything about a mineral interest here.
intro: The Eden Valley Irrigation Project brought farming to this part of Sweetwater County in the early twentieth century, and the original patents came with mineral rights attached, some later severed off through leasing during oil and gas exploration pushes. Separately, this whole corridor along the old Union Pacific right-of-way carries the checkerboard pattern of alternating private and federal sections.
Between farm-family mineral history and the checkerboard's private-versus-federal question, there are two things I need to sort out before quoting you anything, and I'll walk through both.

sections.heading: Irrigated farmland with severed minerals
paragraphs: A lot of Eden-area mineral interests trace to the original reclamation-era homestead patents, split off from the farm surface through decades of leasing and inheritance. That mineral estate is entirely separate from irrigation water rights or the farming operation itself, whether or not the family still works the land.

sections.heading: Checkerboard ownership nearby
paragraphs: Depending on your exact section, your family's interest may trace to a private Union Pacific land grant patent, sellable outright, or to federally retained ground where any minerals are BLM-administered rather than privately held. I check this section by section rather than assuming based on the area generally.

sections.heading: Nearby gas development
paragraphs: The Continental Divide-Creston gas trend runs through parts of Sweetwater County south and east of Eden, and some tracts in this broader area do carry production history. I check your specific legal description against current unit boundaries before saying whether that applies to you.

Between the irrigation history, the checkerboard, and the nearby gas trend, Eden-area ownership questions take a bit more digging than a simpler tract elsewhere in the state. I'd rather take that extra time upfront than give you a number that doesn't hold up once someone looks closer.

faqs.question: Does my irrigation water right affect my mineral ownership?
faqs.answer: No, they're separate legal interests entirely. Selling minerals has no bearing on water rights or farm operations.

faqs.question: How do I know if my section is private or federal minerals?
faqs.answer: Send me your legal description and I'll check it against the original land grant records and county plat.

faqs.question: Is there active gas production near Eden?
faqs.answer: Some nearby sections carry production history tied to regional gas trends. I'll check your specific tract before answering definitively.

faqs.question: What if my family's records only mention the irrigation district, not a legal description?
faqs.answer: That's often enough to start with. I can cross-reference district records against the Sweetwater County plat to find your exact section.
